system_thesis_interpretation: V2 preserves the scientifically honest target: a finite deterministic synthetic protocol for action-conditioned text memory, followed only by an eight-root failure-inclusive DEV description with no population efficacy estimate, no C1--C5 claim, no Stage C or D execution, and no automatic successor. The inherited owner directive prioritizes the science, asks not to reduce the design, and does not waive the repository's exact ratification and scientific-call gates. The proposal correctly treats every new gate as a prospective obligation rather than evidence. Its source integrity is strong: the requested change SHA is exact, all 38 context bindings match their files, the V2 workflow's 38 unique direct-context entries are the same bound set, and the architecture-change validator confirms 27 classes, 8 stages, 216 unique Cartesian cells, and 21 unique acceptance tests. Systems disposition is nevertheless REWORK before ratification. The protocol is conceptually implementable in parts, especially the finite source/target allocation and OLD embargo, physical unpadded-stream-first AS-CTX, fixed event-slot cadence, append-only lineage-local SELF instances, no semantic merge/voting, deterministic pre-output cursor/exhaustion, sterile targets, and the A2/post-B3 chronological split. The exact current bytes are not jointly constructible because the two-AS-EXT rule contradicts the frozen 908-row roster, the closed ontology lacks a closed executable component/stage universe and has circular or undefined identity/equality semantics, the nonreifiable capability bridge lacks an implementable threat/TCB model for ordinary Python or distributed execution, paired RNG over remote/provider inference is stronger than a seed-equality guarantee, and the test/taxonomy/scope artifacts contain exact-ID and state-machine contradictions. Ratification of this scope would authorize only a deliberation already ending at human_required and would not authorize the scoped implementation/tests that AGENTS.md places after ratification.
graph_delta_interpretation: The removal of PCFL_COMPILED_LORA and the positive confirmation-to-LoRA edge is correct, as are distinct nodes for procedural completion, favorable finite description, complete finite null, NOT_RUN, REJECT, invalid text organ, request eligibility, and ineligibility. The graph still needs repair in four places. First, the claimed complete successor state machine has no general incomplete-after-dispatch exit from B1_IN_PROGRESS, B2_IN_PROGRESS, or B3_IN_PROGRESS and admits REJECT only from B3 even though provenance/reproduction rejection can occur earlier. Second, VALID_B1_B3_PROCEDURAL_COMPLETION includes reviewer acceptance of the descriptive label while the reviewer is also supposed to derive the terminal classification, making procedure validation and classification circular. Third, RENDERER_BOUNDARY is declared only a PROCEDURALLY_COMPLETE_NULL subtype even though renderer sensitivity can coexist with all five favorable signs; the precedence would classify that surface FAVORABLE_DESCRIPTIVE and lose the mandatory narrowing. Fourth, there is no nonautomatic post-human-ratification node for a scoped A0--A2 implementation/test request. Under scope_proposal.json, exact ratification produces no actionable next step and instead requires another unspecified SHA-bound scope/ratification cycle. Repair with a total deterministic transition table, phase-separated PROCEDURE_SEAL -> INDEPENDENT_REVIEW -> TERMINAL_CLASSIFICATION, an orthogonal RENDERER_BOUNDARY limitation tag usable with either valid complete outcome, and a nonauthorizing MAY_REQUEST_SCOPED_A0_A2_IMPLEMENTATION transition that still leaves B0/scientific calls separately gated.
loop_delta_interpretation: The retained ordinary-life loop is well specified where it matters: target allocations and support opportunities are frozen before outcomes; later-support OLD sources are embargoed; AS-CTX must be built by physical concatenation and tokenizer retokenization of only realized unpadded public payload before the final L_native suffix; padding cannot enter cognition; fixed envelope slots alone control Dream/snapshot cadence; missed/failed slots stay assigned; SELF proposals, revisions, additions, and failures remain distinct lineage-local instances; semantic equivalence neither merges nor votes; the cursor order is allocation-derived, deterministic, exhaustive, constant-shape, and target-local; and evaluation never writes back. The A2_PREMODEL_CONFIGURATION versus POST_B3_DEV_DISPOSITION ordering is also the correct causal direction, but the selector should receive only registered aggregate/hash derivatives, not full visible A2, clock, failure, or arm classes. The causal fork loop is not yet realizable as written: a routing fabric necessarily handles routing metadata but is absent from the stage ontology; ordinary Python capabilities are inspectable/copyable/addressable unless protected by an OS or capability runtime; literal physical destruction of immutable Python objects, allocator copies, caches, logs, and remote provider state cannot be certified; and PAS_T14 cannot hold a one-use token literally fixed across semantic-mutation trials. Define isolated processes, a named trusted broker/TCB, syscall and IPC boundaries, logical revocation/process teardown semantics, fresh matched tokens per trial, and adversarial transcript equality. For P1, either provide a local deterministic sampler with logged counter-based draws and fixed consumption or downgrade the invariant to exact canonical seed/request equality; common provider seeds alone do not prove identical random draws. No cut/sham resampling and exclusion of assignment/lane metadata from seed derivation remain valid obligations.
claim_delta_interpretation: The intended claim firewall is correct: C0 is only a future construct-conformance target; C1--C4 require a new untouched-root preregistration; C5 is only a possible future associative-successor target; B3 is an eight-root finite DEV description and P1 is a directional chain diagnostic, not formal mediation. The exact test machinery does not yet enforce that firewall. The bound V1 claim namespace/applicability files have change_id V1 and still name the retired PAS_T06_LIFETIME_STATISTICS_POWER_AND_PLATEAU, PAS_T09_A4_REVISION_SENTINEL, and PAS_T10_CONDITIONAL_LORA_READER_AND_CAUSAL_SENTINEL; no V2 map binds their replacements. PAS_T11 still permits DESCRIPTIVE_COMPLETE and NULL instead of the exact V2 FAVORABLE_DESCRIPTIVE and PROCEDURALLY_COMPLETE_NULL vocabulary and omits STOP_TEXT_ORGAN_INVALID. PAS_T04's expected result requires generic SELF to add directional value and lose value under interventions, which turns an efficacy sign into an acceptance condition even though a valid complete absence of that sign must be PROCEDURALLY_COMPLETE_NULL. PAS_T03 retains MEDIATION in an active ID and writes evidence under an active confirm directory, while PAS_T16 and the paper contract require nonclaiming causal-cascade/descriptive semantics. These are machine-readable, not merely rhetorical, conflicts. Add V2 claim_namespace_map and claim_test_applicability artifacts with exact new IDs and states; make PAS_T04 conformance pass for either observed direction while recording the direction for taxonomy; use a descriptive causal-cascade evidence path and either rename PAS_T03 or bind an explicit non-formal alias exception; and make PAS_T11 emit only the V2 terminal vocabulary.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix is exactly Cartesian as declared: 27 distinct information classes times 8 distinct stage labels yields 216 unique cells, with 136 forbidden, 48 visible, and 32 derived_only. That count is not a closed enforceable visibility ontology. The retained contract names distinct generator, opportunity allocator, target allocator/certifier, renderer, scheduler, ordinary actor, environment executor, extractor, Dream-1, Dream-2, sleeper, index/reader, evaluation installer/actor, scorer, resource auditor, selector, analyst, and routing roles, while V2 collapses or omits them. The omission is operationally fatal: HIDDEN_TRUTH_AND_TARGET_ALLOCATION is forbidden to B3_COGNITIVE_AND_TARGET_PATH and visible only to TERMINAL_AUDITOR, so no named environment/scorer stage is authorized to execute hidden-state transitions and score; ARM_AND_CAPACITY_ASSIGNMENT has no ordinary trusted installer stage; scheduler/renderer and resource-auditor stages are absent. The Section-4 'maximum positive readers' table also conflicts with cells granting TERMINAL_AUDITOR public events and granting randomizer/B3/selector/auditor SCHEDULE_AND_CLOCK_STATE. Coarse B3_COGNITIVE_AND_TARGET_PATH visibility to the entire A2 class cannot enforce that each component receives only its own frozen subset. COMPOUND_RESTRICTED is forbidden everywhere, yet ordinary serialized objects will combine public, schedule, status, provenance, or branch taints; the promised future positive-reader amendment would itself change the ratified matrix. TERMINAL_AUDITOR is visibly allowed live EXPLORATION_CAPABILITY_AND_HANDLE_METADATA despite mandatory destruction, and POST_B3_REPORTER_SELECTOR is visibly allowed full A2 and schedule state although it needs only hashes and sealed aggregates. Replace the 8-stage abstraction with a closed component registry or an exact component-to-stage projection plus per-component intersections, add the missing router/broker, environment, scorer, scheduler/renderer, installer, and auditor roles, make live handles forbidden after reset, make selector inputs derived-only, and define derived_only as a concrete registered transform rather than unrestricted aggregate prose.
acceptance_test_interpretation: All tests are prospective obligations and no evidence artifact exists now. Exact systems dispositions follow. PAS_T01_TOTAL_WORLD_OPPORTUNITY_TARGET_AND_CONTEXT: SPECIFICATION_CONDITIONALLY_CONSTRUCTIBLE; retain total preallocation, latest-possible-support OLD embargo, complete finite packet enumeration, physical unpadded-stream-first AS-CTX, dual clocks, strict inequalities, and failure rows, subject to a machine-readable finite schema. PAS_T02_ON_POLICY_ACTION_AND_D4_HEADROOM: SPECIFICATION_CONDITIONALLY_CONSTRUCTIBLE; the exact controller and exhaustive lower-depth/nonadaptive certificates must be executable and target correctness must remain representation-neutral. PAS_T03_RANDOMIZED_UNMOUNTED_MEDIATION: REWORK; retained clone/unmount/common-prior-plus-delta and cumulative-link accounting are sound, but exact token-level CRN is not guaranteed by provider seed equality, the active MEDIATION ID and confirm evidence path conflict with semantic lint, and content-blind isolation depends on T14 repair. PAS_T04_MODEL_OWNED_COMPILER_AND_MECHANICAL_CONTROL: REWORK; identity, nonmerge/nonvote, addition, cadence, cursor/exhaustion, cuts, and full resources are implementable, but favorable SELF direction must be a recorded descriptive outcome, not acceptance/conformance, or valid nulls become invalid. PAS_T05_TEXT_BASELINES_AND_DEV_SELECTION: REWORK; the phase split is right, but executing both AS-EXT candidates through every full-surface B3 cell adds 128 arm-target rows per root and cannot coexist with 908 rows/root. PAS_T06_B3_DESCRIPTIVE_REPORTING_AND_DEFER_INTEGRITY: SPECIFICATION_ACCEPTABLE_AFTER_ROSTER_FIX; it correctly forbids inference and retains failures, but its 7,264 ledger must follow the repaired T05 arithmetic. PAS_T07_DESCENDANT_VISIBILITY_TAINT_RESET: REWORK; mutation semantics are valuable, but a 27x8 coarse table cannot exercise the missing actual components and physical erasure must be replaced by a testable revocation/teardown boundary. PAS_T08_RESOURCE_CALENDAR_AND_STAGE_LOCK: REWORK; stage nonautomaticity is correct, but 908/7,264 and both complete AS-EXT series conflict, and this deliberation-only scope provides no post-ratification implementation transition. PAS_T09_A4_ROW_SCORING_STERILITY_INTEGRITY: SPECIFICATION_ACCEPTABLE_AFTER_NAMESPACE_FIX; it properly treats any efficacy value including zero as valid and keeps A4 outside P1--P4, but needs the V2 claim/test map. PAS_T10_TEXT_STAGE_D_NOT_REQUESTED: REWORK_EXACT_LITERAL; evidence_artifact is NO_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED:NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D although the bound repair requires the literal NO_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED; keep status separately as NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D and require no artifact. PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLAIM_FIREWALL: REWORK; it references V1 maps with retired T06/T09/T10 IDs and emits stale DESCRIPTIVE_COMPLETE/NULL states instead of exact V2 terminal states. PAS_T12_PREMODEL_COGNITION_BYTE_FREEZE: SPECIFICATION_CONDITIONALLY_CONSTRUCTIBLE; retain all exact bytes/goldens and explicit authority, adding immutable runtime/container/backend versions and a realizable sampler/isolation manifest. PAS_T13_CLOSED_FIELD_INFORMATION_ONTOLOGY: REWORK; field_uid is undefined or circular if bundle_hash includes the registry that contains the UID, U_inst=E_inst lacks trace-indexed semantics for mutually exclusive alternatives/crashes, Markdown cannot be canonically traversed as a schema, and the component universe is not closed. PAS_T14_CONTENT_BLIND_FORK_ASSIGNMENT: REWORK; Python objects do not supply the promised nonreifiable/unforgeable/no-copy capability, the routing fabric is an undeclared privileged role, literal token reuse contradicts install_once, and physical destruction/provider nonretention is unprovable without a threat model and TCB. PAS_T15_PREMODEL_POSTDEV_PHASE_SPLIT: SPECIFICATION_ACCEPTABLE_AFTER_VISIBILITY_AND_CLASSIFIER_FIX; chronology and nonreachability are correct, but selector access must be hash/aggregate-only and classification/review ordering must be acyclic. PAS_T16_GRAPH_TEST_CLAIM_SEMANTIC_LINT: CURRENT_SPECIFICATION_FAILS_OWN_LINT; active confirm path, stale V1 applicability IDs, T10 evidence literal, T11 status vocabulary, and T04 outcome-as-gate semantics must be repaired. PAS_T17_SEMANTIC_RENDERING_SHORTCUT_RED_TEAM: REWORK_OPERATIONALIZATION; the strata and stop/narrow principle are good, but the held-out root/renderer roster, author-independence custody, predictor classes, training seeds, thresholds, and finite meaning of 'solves' must be frozen, and a finite audit cannot prove absence of every pretrained semantic shortcut. PAS_T18_NATIVE_RESOURCE_ESTIMANDS_AND_PARETO_FRONTIER: REWORK_COMPARABILITY; separate capability and resource estimands are correct, but NOT_MEASURED energy/FLOPs/dollars lack an applicability/comparability rule, so exact partial dominance is undefined when either side lacks a coordinate; bind units, precision, missingness, and pairwise coordinate domains. PAS_T19_POLICY_PRIOR_VERSUS_LIFE_MEMORY_ATTRIBUTION: REWORK_SCORING; misbinding and fair raw-evidence controls are valuable, but MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE does not define the exact per-item/root inequality meant by directional separation, and a natural-language single-return recommendation is not decidably excluded by a finite typed-controller/paraphrase audit; specify an operational finite predicate and limit the conclusion to that audit. PAS_T20_PAPER_RESULT_TAXONOMY_AND_LANGUAGE_LOCK: REWORK_STATE_ORDER; language is appropriately conservative, but valid-completion/reviewer classification is circular, RENDERER_BOUNDARY is not orthogonal, and missing-after-dispatch versus REJECT precedence is inconsistent. PAS_T21_ASSOCIATIVE_SUCCESSOR_ROUTING: REWORK_NOT_TOTAL; favorable and valid null completion should both be eligible only to request fresh deliberation, but the enumerated machine omits incomplete exits from B1/B2/B3, omits early rejection routes, and has no actionable post-ratification implementation-scope request. Therefore the exact aggregate disposition is REWORK, not ratify/proceed and not scientific rejection of the research target.
assumptions: Every V2 gate, matrix cell, phase, resource coordinate, result class, and successor route is interpreted as a prospective protocol obligation; none is evidence of current implementation, conformance, scientific execution, or a result.

The V2 workflow direct-context set means its directive_file plus context_files; those 38 unique paths exactly match the 38 hash-bound context entries in change.json, while change.json itself is the additional interpretation source.

The exact original directive is interpreted together with AGENTS.md: persistence and broad user enthusiasm do not override the later exact human ratification, independent-review, scientific-call, or GPU gates.

A target-evaluation row is keyed at least by arm or condition, side, checkpoint or snapshot, and target, as demonstrated by the retained arithmetic 64 targets per side times two sides times six full-surface arms equals 768 ordinary rows.

Physical AS-CTX means concatenate only canonical unpadded agent-visible payload bytes in slot order, retokenize that concatenation, then take the target-independent last L_native tokens; an envelope/KV stream with padding masked or stripped after truncation is nonconforming.

No semantic merge or voting means duplicate or disagreeing model outputs always retain distinct immutable record_instance_id and lineage state; semantic_equivalence_key may only index literal equality and cannot affect admission, lifecycle, capacity, rank, or cursor order.

Destruction is assumed intended to mean a verifiable no-reachability/no-use boundary after revocation and isolated process teardown, because literal erasure of every immutable-language, allocator, OS, and remote-provider copy is not generally achievable.

A valid complete B3 null is a legitimate finite outcome and must not fail merely because SELF lacks a favorable direction; only predeclared construct, integrity, completeness, or authority violations make the organ invalid.
No added A-stage fixture or B1/B2 diagnostic is counted as an independent scientific unit, but every model call, action, byte, failure, and resource use must still have a preallocated ledger slot.

The recommended rework is bounded to making the nine V2 repairs mutually executable and machine-consistent; it does not reopen population inference, add Stage C/D, or authorize any implementation or run.

ambiguities.question: What exact byte domain defines bundle_hash in field_uid, and does it exclude the registry and ontology manifest that themselves contain field_uids?
ambiguities.impact: If bundle_hash is the later change or bundle hash that binds the registry, field UID generation is self-referential; if it is a different prehash, identity and reproduction are undefined until that domain and canonicalization are fixed.

ambiguities.question: Which exact V1/V2 executable component maps to each of the eight matrix stages, and where are generator, allocators, renderer/scheduler, environment, evaluation installer, scorer, resource auditor, ordinary arm installer, and routing fabric represented?
ambiguities.impact: Without an exact total component-to-stage map, the 216 cells cannot authorize required reads or prove noninterference; hidden-world execution and scoring currently have no clear legal reader.

ambiguities.question: Are linked and rolling AS-EXT candidate evaluations distinct target-evaluation rows on the full B3 surface, and if not, what exact row key lets two separately reported outcomes and failures occupy one assigned row?
ambiguities.impact: Under the retained arm-target row definition they add 128 rows per root, changing 908 to 1,036 and 7,264 to 8,288; no current artifact supplies a coherent alternative accounting.

ambiguities.question: Does destroyed require physical byte erasure from Python heaps, allocator copies, OS caches, logs, queues, crash dumps, and provider infrastructure, or logical revocation plus process/container teardown and non-reachability?
ambiguities.impact: The physical reading is not generally certifiable in ordinary Python/distributed/provider execution; the logical reading is testable but must be defined and bounded by a trusted-computing-base and retention contract.

ambiguities.question: Does paired compiler RNG require identical provider seed/request fields, identical underlying uniform draws at every token position, or only a deterministic seed derivation?
ambiguities.impact: Remote/provider seed APIs and nondeterministic kernels generally cannot prove token-level common random numbers; the required evidence and feasible backend differ materially across these interpretations.

ambiguities.question: What exact finite algorithm decides that a single natural-language record/return determines a probe or complete trajectory, and what exact inequality, aggregation level, and failure rule define directional separation for MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE?
ambiguities.impact: Without these definitions, T19 can neither emit deterministic per-item values nor distinguish a valid null attribution result from construct invalidity.

ambiguities.question: Does the independent reviewer first validate a procedure seal and then separately validate a deterministic classification, or is reviewer acceptance itself an input to VALID_B1_B3_PROCEDURAL_COMPLETION?
ambiguities.impact: The latter is circular; it prevents a single-pass reproducible terminal classifier and obscures whether REJECT or STOP has precedence for incomplete packages.

ambiguities.question: Is the requested human decision intentionally architecture-only with no actionable post-ratification work, or should ratification permit a separately bounded minimal A0--A2 implementation/test phase while retaining a later exact B0/GPU/scientific-call gate?
ambiguities.impact: As written, ratification authorizes only non-scientific deliberation through human_required, which is already complete at decision time, and requires an unspecified additional scope and ratification before any implementation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The requirement to execute both AS-EXT candidates through every B3 cell is incompatible with exactly 908 target-evaluation rows per root and 7,264 total.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The retained arithmetic has 64 ordinary targets per side, two sides, and six full-surface arms, yielding 768 ordinary rows; adding the second full-surface AS-EXT arm adds 128 rows per root. The other 140 assigned rows remain, so the coherent total is 1,036 per root and 8,288 over eight roots. Calling both outputs one row would hide a condition-specific outcome/failure and violate complete reporting.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Choose and bind one coherent design before ratification: either update every roster, resource, completeness, test, and release count to 1,036 rows/root and 8,288 total, or run a separately pre-B3 frozen candidate contest that selects one AS-EXT before the 908-row B3 surface. Do not use post-B3 selection while counting only one candidate's full-surface rows.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The 27-by-8 matrix must not be called a closed enforceable visibility contract until the executable component universe and its exact projection are closed.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Required roles named by retained contracts are absent or conflated. In particular, hidden truth is visible only to TERMINAL_AUDITOR and forbidden to B3_COGNITIVE_AND_TARGET_PATH, leaving no authorized environment/scorer path; ordinary installation, renderer/scheduler, resource audit, and routing fabric are likewise missing. Coarse visibility to all A2 bytes also defeats component-level least privilege.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add a hash-bound closed component registry and either a full 27-by-component matrix or an exact total component-to-stage mapping followed by component-specific intersection rules. Include generator, allocators/certifier, renderer/scheduler, environment, ordinary/evaluation installers and actors, scorer, resource auditor, broker/routing fabric, and terminal roles; validate exact Cartesian coverage over that closed universe.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: PAS_T13 cannot be implemented deterministically from the current field_uid and U_inst=E_inst definitions.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: If bundle_hash binds the registry containing field_uid, identity is circular; Markdown contract prose has no canonical schema traversal; and a single E_inst cannot equal a U_inst containing mutually exclusive success, timeout, malformed, denied, reset, crash, and unavailable alternatives unless equality is defined over trace-indexed planned slots or a union-of-fixtures coverage domain. COMPOUND_RESTRICTED also forbids every stage while anticipating later positive readers, which would require a new matrix change.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define a non-self-referential schema-set digest that excludes generated IDs; make machine-readable schemas the sole U_def source with an explicit prose-to-schema inventory; define per-trace planned/emitted equality plus a separate suite-coverage union for alternatives and supervisor-emitted crash slots; keep one base class plus a taint-source set and compute permissions directly instead of an all-forbidden catch-all requiring later amendment.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Nonserializable, unforgeable, nonreifiable, no-copy write-only install capabilities are not an enforceable ordinary Python/distributed abstraction without a specified trusted runtime.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A callable object is addressable and introspectable in a Python process; cross-process routing uses a reifiable OS or network handle; the routing fabric necessarily observes route metadata but is not modeled; an installer necessarily associates each treatment with the capability it invokes; one-use capabilities cannot be held literally fixed across mutation trials; and physical erasure of all copies/provider state cannot be proven by an application receipt.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Specify the adversary and non-collusion assumptions; name a minimal broker/TCB; use isolated processes or containers with explicit syscall, file, network, log, and crash-dump policy; define capabilities as broker-owned single-use channels with opaque fresh per-trial handles; compare canonical public transcripts rather than token identity; and define destruction as revocation plus worker teardown and bounded non-reachability, with remote providers excluded unless their retention/cache contract suffices.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The exact paired-RNG obligation cannot rely on a digest-to-provider seed conversion alone.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Provider implementations, distributed kernels, cache state, request order, variable stopping, and backend revisions can make equal seed fields consume different or nondeterministic random streams. That proves seed pairing, not equality of underlying draws index by index.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: For true common random numbers, use a pinned local deterministic sampler driven by a logged counter-based uniform stream indexed by sample and token position, with fixed stopping/consumption rules and golden vectors. Otherwise rename the obligation to paired canonical seed/request equality and do not claim exact shared draws.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The V2 registry does not have a coherent exact claim-to-test namespace.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The bound claim namespace and applicability files have V1 change_id and retain the three historical T06/T09/T10 IDs, while V2 registers replacements. PAS_T10's evidence_artifact is not the required literal NO_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED, PAS_T11 returns stale result names, and PAS_T03 writes to an active confirm path despite the semantic lint. Therefore PAS_T11 and PAS_T16 cannot both pass on the exact current bytes.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add hash-bound V2 namespace/applicability artifacts with exact set equality to all current proposal claims and applicable current test IDs; set T10 evidence_artifact exactly to NO_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED and status separately; replace DESCRIPTIVE_COMPLETE/NULL with V2 terminal names; and move T03 evidence to a descriptive causal-cascade path, renaming or explicitly machine-aliasing MEDIATION as non-formal.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: PAS_T04's favorable-direction expectation conflicts with PROCEDURALLY_COMPLETE_NULL as a valid complete outcome.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The test expects generic SELF to add directional value beyond controls and lose value under interventions. Under the V2 taxonomy, absence of a favorable descriptive sign after valid complete B3 is a null/boundary, not compiler-conformance failure or organ invalidity. An acceptance gate that requires the sign collapses null into STOP and makes terminal classification result-dependent in the wrong layer.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Split T04 into a conformance/integrity predicate that passes for complete correctly scored observations of any sign and a separately recorded descriptive sign consumed only by the terminal classifier. Apply the same separation anywhere a B1/B2 spending sign versus a B3 descriptive sign is currently ambiguous.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The claimed exact result/successor state machine is incomplete and partly circular.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Incomplete-after-dispatch is explicit only from B0, REJECT is explicit only from B3, and no transition handles an incomplete B1/B2/B3 package generally. Procedural completion depends on reviewer acceptance of the label that review is supposed to classify. RENDERER_BOUNDARY is forced under null even when every favorable sign may hold. These gaps prevent exactly one mutually exclusive terminal state for every trace.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Enumerate every state/event pair with an ordered transition: pre-dispatch absence -> NOT_RUN; any in-progress incomplete/abort -> STOP_TEXT_ORGAN_INVALID:INCOMPLETE_AFTER_DISPATCH; sealed-package provenance/reproduction/claim-lint rejection -> REJECT; validity failure -> STOP; valid procedure seal -> independent review -> deterministic favorable/null classification. Make renderer limitation an orthogonal tag and test totality/exclusivity mechanically.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: scope_proposal.json makes exact V2 ratification retrospective and nonactionable rather than the scope gate preceding implementation in AGENTS.md.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: requested_scope authorizes only role-model deliberation calls through human_required, while forbidden_scope excludes every implementation and CPU fixture. authorization_effect says later implementation requires a new exact SHA-bound scope and explicit ratification. Once a human can ratify, the only authorized work is already complete, and neither graph nor state machine identifies a bounded implementation-scope request.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Either explicitly label this decision architecture-only and add MAY_REQUEST_SCOPED_A0_A2_IMPLEMENTATION with an exact follow-on scope artifact that does not reopen the architecture, or include a narrowly enumerated post-ratification A0--A2 implementation/test scope now. Keep B0/model/provider/GPU/scientific execution behind a later independent-review and exact human call authorization.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The resource frontier cannot make exact dominance decisions while allowing NOT_MEASURED coordinates without a pairwise applicability rule.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Dominance requires no greater use on every mandatory resource coordinate, but energy and FLOPs may be unavailable and recorded NOT_MEASURED. The contract neither makes such configurations RESOURCE_INCOMPLETE nor removes those coordinates prospectively for a pair. Units, numeric precision, concurrency allocation, shared-cost allocation, and comparison tolerance are also not fixed.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze a coordinate schema with units, direction, precision/rounding, measurement boundary, shared-cost allocation, and a pairwise applicability mask before B0. Treat an applicable NOT_MEASURED coordinate as incomparable/ineligible for dominance; allow exclusion only when prospectively declared for both configurations and reported.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The shortcut and single-return gates must be framed as finite operational falsifiers, not proofs that no semantic or policy-prior route exists.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Whether arbitrary natural-language content determines an action for a stochastic pretrained controller is not decidable from a static DSL scan plus finitely many paraphrases. T17 does not bind the held-out roster, attack generator, predictor family, training randomness, or solution threshold, and T19 does not define the exact directional-separation reducer for MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Bind a finite audit domain, seeds, models, controller build, typed action predicate, thresholds, and root/renderer split; instrument explicit dataflow/reference IDs for path use; define per-item and root aggregation for authentic versus misbound/raw controls; and limit conclusions to absence of a shortcut in those predeclared audits. Keep any detected hard route as STOP_TEXT_ORGAN_INVALID.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Several positive visibility cells are broader than the phase and destruction contracts permit.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: POST_B3_REPORTER_SELECTOR is visible to full A2_PREMODEL_CONFIGURATION and SCHEDULE_AND_CLOCK_STATE and to full failure/prior/resource classes, although it needs frozen hashes and registered aggregates only. TERMINAL_AUDITOR is visible to EXPLORATION_CAPABILITY_AND_HANDLE_METADATA even though all live capabilities and handles must be destroyed and a distinct absence-receipt class exists. These grants make least privilege depend on prose outside the matrix.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Change selector access to exact derived-only hash/aggregate fields with a closed transform registry; forbid live capability/handle metadata to the terminal auditor and provide only sealed assignment records plus DESTRUCTION_AND_ABSENCE_RECEIPT; split broad classes where source and audit derivatives have different lifetimes.
